segments.text: THE latter two queſtions of Baptiſme before expounded, are alſo common vnto the doctrine of circumciſion: & thoſe thinges, which may bee ſpoken of circumciſion, are not vnfitly annexed vnto the doctrine of baptiſme. It remaineth therefore, that we briefly diſcuſſe thoſe queſtions which are eſpeciallie to be obſerued concerning circumciſion. Theſe are in number fower.

1 What circumciſion is.
2 What are the ends of circumciſion.
3 Why it is aboliſhed.
4 Why chriſt was circumciſed.
